thread:
Ava Patel: Quick weekly release-train broadcast — two operational notes and one policy update. Read and ack.

Sanjay Rao: Note A: Freeze window scheduled for Thu 2026-04-08 18:00 PT -> Mon 2026-04-12 08:00 PT. No standard deploys into prod during window. Only approved rollback/security hotfixes allowed.

Ava Patel: Policy tweak: starting this cycle, freeze exception approvals require both Program Manager and SRE sign-off (two approvers). See new process here: https://redwood.example.com/ops/release-freeze-policy.

Marta (eng-sre): If you expect a migration to cross the freeze, raise early. We'll either schedule a pre-freeze cutover or require a documented exception request.

deploy-bot: Canary initiated: routing-service v1.9 at 2026-03-30T09:10:00Z 0.5% traffic. Canary dashboard: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canaries/3912400001-routing-v1.9

Devon Li: Canary logs look clean so far. p50/p95 unchanged, small memory bump on host-12 but within headroom. I'll watch for 45m.

Ava Patel: Heads-up: feature-flag `route_v1_9` will be toggled off for prod during freeze unless exception approved.

OpsLead (oncall): To request an exception use the Freeze Exception form: https://forms.gle/freeze-exception-new 0ps please include: risk summary, rollback steps, test URLs, owner contact. Triage SLA: 3 hours.

Sanjay Rao: Rollout note: autoscaler default burst cap is increasing next week; if you rely on fine-grained rate limiting, check your service config. Opt-out by filing ticket with "burst-optout" tag.

Marta (eng-sre): Observed one small spike on queue-processor (host-21) during initial ramp, restarted container. No user impact. Filing a sticky issue if repeats.

Devon Li: Small reminder: internal canaries on staging are permitted during freeze. Production-facing canaries require an approved exception.

Ava Patel: Action items: 1) Service owners confirm here if you have migrations or schema changes that will attempt promotion during the freeze. 2) Re-schedule non-critical deploys. 3) If you need the two-approver flow expedited, ping me and @Marta.

Sanjay Rao: Quick Q: Will security hotfixes still follow fast-track?

Ava Patel: Yes 1) security hotfixes follow fast-track, 2) SRE still vets rollback path, 3) PM signs off on customer communication if needed.

deploy-bot: Pinned and archived summary posted: https://confluence.redwood.internal/pages/release-train/3912400001-summary

Ava Patel: Thanks folks 1 please ack with a quick reaction or reply if you have conflicts or blockers.
